Every root test that waits keeps the shared 12 s `WITHIN` under the 20 s lint; the rig rehearsal of `TS` drives a
verify and sits where the `V` rehearsal sits, its kill the one that binary already has. The harness boot is not a
touchpoint and no boot-path file changes beyond the start (`src/cmd/run.rs` is exercised by every booted case), so the
operator pass boots one session `trust-smoke` as the last chunk did and reads it. No mutation run (directive item 7).

The remove-the-guard controls are implement's one-shot `gate.py control` runs, not entries (validation.md check 4 (6)),
each fired with `--timeout 900` (sized to the integration entry's build plus its named cases, each case bounded by
`WITHIN`), each control's entry named; «holds» means each named case ran and FAILED with no TIMEOUT line:

- `trust-nocall` — `src/cmd/run.rs`: the start's trust call removed (no file read, no line); entry: the named
  integration entry; case `run_in_an_untrusted_folder_writes_the_record_and_types_no_key`. With the guard gone the
  subject starts its child in the untrusted folder, the fake draws the trust form and fires no SessionStart; the case's
  wait for it ends at `WITHIN` — unmeasured until this control runs.

- `trust-gate` — `src/cmd/run.rs`: the `cli_verified` arm removed (the write made on an unverified CLI); entry: the
  named integration entry; case `run_on_an_unverified_home_writes_nothing`. With the guard gone the record is written on
  an unverified home — unmeasured until this control runs.

- `trust-walk` — `crates/viola-agent-claude/src/trust.rs`: the walk cut to the exact key; entry: `cargo nextest run -p
  viola-agent-claude`; case `trust_walk_reads_the_exact_key_then_each_parent`. With the guard gone a subfolder of a
  trusted parent is written a needless record — unmeasured until this control runs.

- `trust-exact` — `src/trust_record.rs`: the read-back cut to the flag alone; entry: `bash scripts/agent-run.sh run
  --unit`; case `trust_start_read_back_with_an_added_key_is_lost`. With the guard gone a raced entry reads `written` —
  unmeasured.

  `first-screen: trust` (the two live entries).

- (security) Each refusal form writes nothing and leaves the dialog to the human: `run_trust_refusals_write_nothing`
  (absent, link, not regular, malformed, oversize, lock held) and `trust_start_refusals_write_nothing` /

- (security) No record on an unverified CLI, for a folder the exact key or a parent already trusts, or for the home

- (security, F-T1) An entry standing without a true flag gets only the flag:
  `run_with_the_entry_flag_false_sets_only_the_flag` and `flag_only_set_keeps_every_other_key` (inputs#I2 item 4).
- (security) The file is the one the child reads: `run_with_the_config_dir_kept_writes_that_file`.
- (a11y) A trust-writing start puts no viola byte on the terminal: `passthrough_of_a_trust_writing_start_adds_no_viola_bytes`.

- (tests) The changed binaries, the whole integration and E2E layers and both unit entries return green; the six
  controls read «holds».
